verdict.rationale: Probes at the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on docs.requesty.ai all returned 404, and no evidence shows a downloadable machine-readable API spec. The llms.txt and markdown docs are machine-readable documentation, not an API spec. OpenAI SDK compatibility does not mean Requesty publishes its own spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
